prompt:
Extract one invoice from the user text. Output only one JSON object with exactly the keys below. Values are strings or null. Use null for unstated fields; never guess or compute values from other fields, terms, or rates.

- vendor: issuer's full legal name as written, including suffix; never the customer or bill-to party.
- invoice_number: invoice ID as written, without its label; not an order, PO or customer ID.
- issue_date: invoice issue date, not order or delivery date.
- due_date: stated payment due date only.
- currency: billing currency, one of EUR, SEK, USD, GBP, CHF, NOK, DKK. Map €→EUR, £→GBP, $→USD, kr→SEK. Ignore informational currency conversions and converted amounts.
- net: stated taxable amount excluding VAT after any discount, not the pre-discount subtotal or a line-item amount unless labeled net.
- vat: stated VAT or sales-tax amount, not the rate.
- total: stated gross amount payable including VAT.

Convert dates to YYYY-MM-DD, including written months and ordinal days. Preserve ISO year-month-day order; otherwise read numeric dates day-first even when ambiguous. Expand two-digit years to 20YY. Format amounts as decimal strings with a dot and exactly two decimals, without grouping, spaces or currency; the last comma or dot followed by two digits marks the decimals.

Read English, Swedish and German labels. Interpret broken lines and OCR typos in labels or prose from context; values are uncorrupted.
